title: The Dimension of the Two-Adic Hecke Algebra at Odd Level
summary: For every odd positive integer N , every irreducible component of the full two-adic Hecke algebra of level $`\Gamma_1(N)`$ has Krull dimension four. This proves the p = 2 case of Emerton's dimension conjecture, including all residual components.
family_title: Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two

review.reason: Computes Krull dimension of two-adic Hecke algebras at odd level, proving a case of Emerton's conjecture.
